rows.label: tlk70000013_02_msg0001
rows.name:
I don't care if it's Heaven's Holy
Grail or whatever. What an outrageous
thing to do.

rows.label: tlk70000013_02_msg0002
rows.name:
I'm not just talking about wrecking
the city, either! Blades set against
humans harms our very culture.

rows.label: tlk70000013_02_msg0003
rows.name:
This country isn't united, you know.
Some people are reluctant about the
idea of coexistence with Blades.

rows.label: tlk70000013_02_msg0004
rows.name:
They're called the anti-Adel faction.
I just hope they don't get any strange
ideas...

rows.label: tlk70000013_02_msg0005
rows.name:
In any case, I'm not letting this
country fall apart without a fight.
It's my home, and I love it.
